about: SPEC-v3.5 §1: the parts library. `thing`: every thing part. A base has `spots` (where other parts may go); a top or a wrap has `on` (the spots it may sit on). `layer` is behind, body or front. `glow`: it gets a soft halo. `sound`: what it sounds like (§3.4). `kinds`: for every kind in kinds.json, the base part it is built on and the signature part it gives to an invention. `rules`: the composition limits. The engine composes inventions from the names here; the view draws them. Drawing fields (file, rect, where each spot is in pixels, regions) are added per part by the art. SPEC-v3.6d §3: designs are composed from up to `rules.max_design_parts` of these (engine/design.py); SPEC-v5.1: what each part gives, needs and can be made of is parts.toml (the root), which names every part here by its `draw`.

body.about: The body parts a genome's slots name (bodies.json), as the view stamps them on a pet: `frames` are <view>.<size> (front, side facing right, back; l, or s for a body under `small` pixels wide), a mouth's <what it does>.<1 or 2 middle columns, or side>.<size>. `layer`: behind the body, in front of it, or on it. `pair`: one each side, mirrored. `plans`: each body plan as proportions of the one body.
